name: document-format-skills
title_zh: 中文公文排版一步到位，连修订痕迹都替你管好
tagline_zh: 混排中英文标点、表格页码、公文模板一键归一。Codex 改完的 Word 不再被领导退回重排，修订痕迹想留就留。
tagline_en: Fix mixed punctuation, tables, page numbers, and apply official templates in one pass. Keep or strip revision.
desc_en: Chinese Word document formatting toolkit for .docx/.doc/.wps workflows. Use when Codex needs to diagnose document formatting, fix mixed Chinese/English punctuation and spacing, apply official/academic/legal/custom presets, normalize tables and page numbers, preserve or output Word revision marks, convert plain text or Markdown into formatted DOCX, or batch/script document cleanup for Chinese offic
why_zh: 不是零散宏命令，而是按中文办公流程组织的成套动作：先诊断再修，模板与自定义并存，批注修订有明确开关。
why_en: Not scattered macros—a workflow-shaped suite: diagnose first, then fix. Official and custom templates coexist; revision marks.
limit_zh: 只认 .docx/.doc/.wps 输入，输出为 DOCX；不处理 PDF 或扫描件。
limit_en: Inputs .docx/.doc/.wps only, outputs DOCX. No PDF/OCR. Revision marks work only with Word-native tracking; WPS compatibility-mode revisions may.
title_en: Chinese doc formatting toolkit with revision-mark control
